checkedAlternates.risk: Iconic memory holds visual information briefly like the visuospatial sketchpad.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Iconic memory is a precategorical <500 ms sensory buffer (group-1), whereas the visuospatial sketchpad actively manipulates visual representations in working memory (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Procedural skills are stored in long-term memory.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Procedural memory is unconscious non-declarative motor knowledge (group-3), distinct from consciously recalled declarative facts/events (group-4).
